about: D for [levels] calibrated 2 (option B'): dB a velocity technique plays over the part's held Long at the same marking (map <Articulation heldOffset>, gen_spitfire_sso.py). Written by technique_offsets.py; a technique of the five string sections not listed here keeps SSO's own loud-end difference (SoundLib::loudEndDb): an assumption, no real-player data.

staccato.method: per section median(staccato) - median(held) at f, perceived (STL); pooled = mean of the sections; 90 % interval by a two-level bootstrap (sections, then notes), 20000 draws
staccato.choice: pooled for all five sections: one held note per measured section (Violins 1, Celli, Basses); the sections differ by 3.1 dB (SD), about one held note's own variation (2.6-4.2 dB SD, the first readings), so one held note each can't separate them; Violins 2 (no single held note at f in bars 28-33: double stops) and Violas not measured
assumptions: the same D at every marking (measured at f only; untested at p)
Violins 2 and Violas take the pooled value (not measured)

quarters.method: as staccato: quarter notes (bars 1-9) against whole notes (bars 10-15) at p, Celli and Basses
assumptions: Short 1.0 (a full-length bowed short) plays as these unaccented quarters
measured at p only; Violins and Violas take the Celli / Basses value

pizzicato.method: pizzicato minus arco at pp and ff, linear in the written dynamic's CC between (pp CC 32, ff CC 112), constant outside
pizzicato.source: Meyer 2009, Acoustics and the Performance of Music, ch. 3 (sound power, not perceived: an uncertainty of several dB)

corroboration.source: University of Iowa Musical Instrument Samples (5 sessions, 5 players: violin, viola, double bass): each pizzicato note's peak loudness (ISO 532-1) against a held arco note at the same marking; measured 2026-10-15
corroboration.note: median and range over the sessions; only pp agrees within 3 dB across sessions; independent corroboration of Meyer, uncertainty about +-3-4 dB; not used for the values

zero.why: SSO's own loud-end difference disagrees by ~10 dB between the perceived and the 50 ms metric (2026-10-15 validation): D = 0, SSO's balance at the matched level (an assumption)
